sources.snippet: Falcon-H1-.5B delivers performance on par with typical 7B models from 2024, while Falcon-H1-1.5B-Deep rivals many of the current leading 7B-10B models. Each Falcon-H1 model is designed to match or exceed the performance of models at least twice its size, making them ideal for low-resource and edge deployments without compromising on capability.
